lines.text: Turn on the light, not open!
Many learners say: Please open the light.
Better: Please turn on the light.
Turn on! Please turn on the light.

native.hook: 开灯不是 open the light！
native.tip: 中文说“开灯”，“开”和开门的“开”是同一个字。英语里灯要用 turn on，关灯用 turn off。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Please open the light.”😅 中文“开灯”用的“开”和开门一样，英语的灯要用 turn on：“Please turn on the light.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“Please turn on the light.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.hook: Turn on the light, not open!
en.tip: Chinese uses the same word for opening a door and turning on a light. English uses turn on for lights, and turn off to stop them.
en.caption: Do you say “Please open the light.” 😅 Lights go with turn on: “Please turn on the light.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
